definitions.gloss: nasal congestion; stuffy nose; blocked nose
definitions.explanation: The condition of having a blocked or congested nose, typically from a cold, allergies, or sinusitis.

examples.japanese: {鼻詰|はなづ}まり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧。
⟦{花粉症|かふんしょう}→花粉症：04409_kafunshou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{鼻詰|はなづ}まり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: I've had a stuffy nose from hay fever.

examples.japanese: {鼻詰|はなづ}まり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどくて→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧、⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れなかった→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧。
examples.english: My nasal congestion was so bad that I couldn't sleep well at night.

notes:
USAGE:
{鼻詰|はなづ}まり describes the symptom of a blocked nose. It is commonly used when talking about colds, allergies, and sinus problems.

FORMS:
⟦{鼻|はな}→鼻：02164_hana⟧ (nose) + {詰|つ}まり (blockage, from ⟦{詰|つ}まる→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧ "to be blocked").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鼻詰|はなづ}まり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧: to have bad nasal congestion
- {鼻詰|はなづ}まり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}する→解消する：21324_kaishousuru⟧: to relieve nasal congestion
- {鼻詰|はなづ}まり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: nasal congestion persists
